orders.title: Orders
basket.title: Basket
toast.no_energy: Out of energy. It refills over time
toast.debris: Merge items next to the rubble to clear it
hint.start: Drag two identical items together to merge them. Tap a generator, then tap it again to get new items.
task.river_festival: Open the chapel for the festival
shop.title: Shop
shop.coin_energy_hint: A few times a day, pricier each time
shop.coin_energy_tomorrow: That's all for today, come back tomorrow
shop.vip_1: Open the firefly jar any time for free
shop.vip_2: Double gems in the daily gift
shop.vip_3: Support the developer and get a crown
shop.vip_terms: Subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage it in your Apple ID settings.
jar.title: Firefly jar
jar.about: When your energy is full it doesn't go to waste: fireflies slowly collect it in the jar. Open it for free every 8 hours.
jar.empty: The jar is empty for now. Fireflies start collecting when your energy is full.
daily.title: Daily gift
event.how: Every star from orders on the weekend gives a ribbon 🎀
event.fair.title: Fair by the Well
event.fair.intro: Traders are coming to the square. Mila wants to hang garlands, and Tim dreams of a scarecrow to chase crows off the garden.
event.fair.after.mila: Mila hung the flags and the whole village danced until night. The garland is yours.
event.fair.after.tim: Tim set up the scarecrow and the crows flew off in a huff. The scarecrow is yours.
event.harvest.title: Harvest Festival
event.harvest.intro: A great harvest! Mila wants a cozy nest for bees and birds, and Tim asks for a water trough for the hens.
event.harvest.after.mila: A pair of starlings moved into the nest and sing to Mila every morning. The nest is yours.
event.harvest.after.tim: Tim's hens are now the happiest around. The trough is yours.
event.lights.title: Night of Lights
event.lights.intro: Fireflies gather at the village at night. Mila wants torches by the road, and Tim wants a bench to watch the lights.
event.lights.after.mila: The torches burn till dawn with fireflies circling. The torch is yours.
event.lights.after.tim: Tim and Mila sat on the bench until sunrise. The bench is yours.
decor.hint: Tap to place. Drag to move, long press to put away.
decor.empty: Decorations come from postcards, events, friends and the merchant
tutorial.spawn: Hi! I'm Mila. The village is in ruins, but we'll rebuild it. Tap the glowing generator to pick it, then tap it again to get an item.
tutorial.merge: Great! Now drag an item onto a matching one to merge them into something better.
tutorial.deliver: Villagers post orders at the top. When an item is ready, tap Give to earn stars.
tutorial.build: You have stars! Let's go to the village and build something.
settings.title: Settings
shop.piggy_hint: Every order drops %d gems inside. You can break it from %d gems.
shop.piggy_full: The piggy bank is full! Break it so no gems go to waste
shop.piggy_ready: The piggy bank is ready to break! Check the shop
shop.pass_hint: A second reward on every step of this weekend's track
shop.builder_hint: Stars for buildings and a street lamp. One-time offer
boost.on: Boost on: 2 energy for an item one step higher
postcard.title: Postcards
postcard.how: Every order brings a piece. Complete the postcard to get gems, coins and a decoration.
shot.board.title: Merge and match
shot.board.sub: Seeds become pumpkins, twigs become benches
shot.village.title: Bring the village back
shot.village.sub: Rebuild homes, shops and the old mill
shot.north.title: Seven districts to restore
shot.north.sub: Orchard, old mine, fair meadow and more
shot.event.title: Weekend festivals
shot.event.sub: Grant a wish and win a unique decoration
shot.postcard.title: Collect village postcards
shop.stamps_hint: Every purchase adds a stamp. Collect %d for 💎 %d and a rare decoration
toast.basket_only_items: Only items fit in the basket
quests.title: Daily tasks
quests.bigMerge: Make %d items of level 4 or higher
album.title: Album
album.hint: Each new find is marked with a dot: tap it to collect a reward. Complete a whole chain to earn gems.
basket.about: Drag a spare item from the field down to the bottom bar, or tap it and press "To basket". Tap an item here to put it back.
village.move_hint: Hold a building and drag to move it
story.square.intro.1: Oh, a visitor! Our village has been empty for years since the big storm.
story.square.intro.2: Merge things on the field and fill orders. Every order brings stars, and stars rebuild the houses. Let's start with the square!
story.square.done.1: The square is alive again! I can already smell pies from the inn. I'll stay and open my apiary right here.
story.farmstead.intro.1: Past the square lies the old farmstead. Mend the fence, and Chloe will bring her hens back.
story.farmstead.done.1: Fresh eggs, warm bread and the windmill is spinning! I haven't been this happy in ages.
story.riverside.intro.1: The storm took the bridge across the river. Without it no one can reach the northern bank.
story.riverside.intro.2: Fix the bridge and I'll move into the old fishing hut. The fish here are the best in the valley!
story.riverside.done.1: Boats on the water and the chapel bells ready for the festival. The river is ours again!
story.orchard.intro.1: On the north bank there's an overgrown orchard. Katy used to make the finest cider there.
story.orchard.intro.2: Put up a sign so people find the way, and I'll plant cherries, peaches and grapes again!
story.orchard.done.1: The whole orchard smells like summer. Come by for cider any time!
story.hilltop.intro.1: Up on the hill stands the old bell. When it rings, the whole valley hears it.
story.hilltop.intro.2: Rebuild the bakery, the library and the manor, and we'll ring the bell together.
story.hilltop.done.1: The bell rang! Folks from every village are coming to see what happened here.
story.mine.intro.1: North of the hill is the old mine. At night you can hear the crystals humming inside.
story.mine.intro.2: I'm Bruno, I cut gems. Set up a camp for me and I'll bring crystals to the village!
story.mine.done.1: The forge is hot and the carts roll again. Look how the crystals shine in the lamplight!
story.fair.intro.1: Past the mine lies the meadow where the great fair used to be held every autumn.
story.fair.intro.2: Tents, contests, music! Help us bring the fair back and I'll bake for the whole valley.
story.fair.done.1: You did it: the whole valley is alive again. Thank you! There will be a new festival every weekend.
friends.title: Residents
friends.hint: Every order you complete gives a heart to the resident who asked for it. Hearts bring gifts.
friends.about.tim: Village gardener. Knows every seed by name.
friends.about.jack: Woodcutter. Hums a tune with every swing.
friends.about.mike: Stonemason. Builds things to last a hundred years.
friends.about.mila: Beekeeper. Always smells of honey and clover.
friends.about.chloe: Farmer and baker. Up before the roosters.
friends.about.katy: Orchard keeper. Has a story for every apple tree.
friends.about.fin: Fisherman. Swears the river talks at dawn.
friends.about.bruno: Gem cutter. Hears the crystals sing in the mine.
achievements.title: Achievements
achievements.hint: Long goals with bronze, silver and gold. Every step pays gems.
merchant.about: Wandering merchant: bring all three items before he leaves. Every third visit he pays with a rare decoration.
story.merchant.intro.1: Hello there! I travel the valleys with my wagon. I heard your village is coming back to life.
story.merchant.intro.2: Bring me three things before I move on and I'll pay you well. Every third time I'll bring something rare!
story.friends.intro.1: We residents remember every order you fill for us. Open the journal: you'll see who's grown fond of you, and gifts are waiting!
pets.title: Animals
pets.hint: Take animals into the village for coins. They roam their district, and once a day each one has a small gift: tap it on the map.
shortage.gems_hint: Gems come from quests, achievements and the album, or from the shop
shortage.gems_free: %d rewards are waiting in the journal!
top.boost_locked: Generator boost x2 opens at level %d
top.merchant_locked: The wandering merchant comes from level %d
chest.need_space: Free a cell to take an item out of the chest
thicket.hint: Drop the same item here: %@ level %d
thicket.hidden: Something is hidden in the thicket. Clear the cells around it first
chest.items: Tap again for an item. Left: %d
shop.gift_tomorrow: Come back tomorrow for a new gift
adv.title: Event
adv.depths.title: The Depths
adv.depths.how: Dig next to open cells. Earth takes 1 pickaxe, stone 2, granite 3. Finds drop onto the board below: merge them and send them up in the minecart for points. Pickaxes come from orders on the main board.
adv.depths.treasures: Big treasure chests wait at depth 12, 24 and 36. You'll see each one 5 rows ahead.
adv.no_moves: Out of pickaxes: complete orders on the main board
adv.board_full: The board is full: merge or send finds first
adv.track_hint: Points come from finds sent in the minecart. Rewards land on your main board.
adv.board_hint: Tap a find, then a matching one to merge
adv.board_selected: Tap again to send it, or tap another cell
adv.island.title: The Island
adv.island.how: Shells call the tide: it brings a new item to the shore. Move items for free. 3 alike side by side merge into 1, 5 merge into 2. Merges at the edge clear the fog, and gifts hide under it.
adv.island.treasures: Three treasures hide in the fog. You'll see each one when the shore comes close.
adv.island.fog: Fog: merge items next to it to clear it
adv.island.hint: Tap an item, then a cell next to the same ones
adv.island.full: No room on the shore: merge or wash something away
adv.no_shells: Out of shells: complete orders on the main board
adv.greenhouse.title: The Greenhouse
adv.greenhouse.how: Seeds come from orders. Plants grow in real time. Two alike merge into one bigger plant that ripens sooner. Harvest ripe plants for points; bigger ones are worth much more. The watering can refills every 4 hours and speeds everything up by an hour.
adv.greenhouse.golden: A fully grown plant of the last stage also brings a chest to your main board.
adv.greenhouse.full: All beds are taken: merge or harvest first
adv.greenhouse.watered: Watered! Everything grows an hour faster
adv.no_seeds: Out of seeds: complete orders on the main board
adv.mosaic.title: Stained Glass
adv.mosaic.how: Glass comes from orders. Cut a piece onto the workbench: two alike merge into a bigger one that covers far more cells. Drop a piece on a shard of its color to fill the nearest empty cells; extra glass is lost. A finished shard gives a bonus, a finished window gives a big one and a new window.
adv.mosaic.window: Every finished window also brings a chest to your main board.
adv.mosaic.full: The workbench is full: merge pieces or set them in the window
adv.mosaic.done: Window done! Here comes a new one
adv.mosaic.wrong: This piece is a different color
adv.no_glass: Out of glass: complete orders on the main board
adv.lanterns.title: Lantern Night
adv.lanterns.how: Lanterns come from orders. Hang one on any empty spot in the dark village. Tap two alike to merge them: the new lantern lights up where the second one hung and shines farther. Lit spots stay lit. The dark hides wishes, fireflies that bring lanterns, and chests. When the whole village is lit, a new night begins.
adv.lanterns.night: Every fully lit village also brings a chest to your main board. The brightest lantern flies into the sky for bonus points.
adv.lanterns.new_night: The village is lit! A new night falls
adv.lanterns.sky: A lantern flew into the sky! +%d
adv.lanterns.pick: Tap a lantern just like it to merge
adv.no_lanterns: Out of lanterns: complete orders on the main board
